name: Patrick Lynen
reason: Not a spiritual teacher: a German-language success and mindset coach and hypnotist ('Meister der Veränderung') whose site sells coaching packages, a luxury mentoring stay in Mallorca and hypnosis audios including a weight-loss programme, while his most popular Insight Timer tracks are white noise, 'sleep induction' and weight-loss hypnosis; only a lucid-dreaming course and a couple of motivational courses would pass the rules, his site appears little updated since 2020–2023, and the only published email is a help inbox (hilfe@patricklynen.com).
